messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH — Multiple 5xx spikes and elevated p50/p95 for Hosted API + Dedicated pools in eu-west-4. Symptoms: auth token validation latency, observability ingest errors. Auto-runbooks triggered: auth-retry-fallback, region-failover-check.

sasha: I'm oncall. investigating auth upstreams now. seeing a sudden increase in STS/IDP latency from eu-west-4 -> external idp.prod.example.com (200ms -> 2.5s). 5xx correlate with token fetch timeouts.

leo: Confirmed. Bump in egress error rate from eu-west-4 NATs to idp provider. Also seeing observability ingest errors (Ingestly) — spikes in log/metrics write latency, which is slowing trace lookups and some control-plane ops.

priya: Runtime note: when auth validation takes >1s requests fall into sync retry and KV cache misses cause model workers to block, leading to 502s. We're hitting blocking path in auth middleware.

maya: Customer impact: Hosted API region eu-west-4 reporting increased 5xx for ~12 active customers. Dedicated pools in same region showing elevated latency but fewer hard 5xx because they have local token cache. Need quick mitigation plan + support comms.

tom: Support: making triage list. Which customers are most impacted? need to know any enterprise customers on SLAs in that region ASAP. Drafting a message to affected orgs for now.

incident-bot: notes: Alert rule: hosted.api.request_5xx_rate > 3% for 5m. Rate currently 7.1% in eu-west-4.

priya: Mitigation options: 1) enable cached-token fallback to bypass real-time IDP calls for short-lived tokens (safe for 60s), 2) route new requests from eu-west-4 to eu-west-2/ eu-central-1 via smart-routing policy, 3) increase request timeouts and add extra retries to IDP calls (risk: more in-flight requests). Recommend 1+2.

sasha: I'm applying cached-token fallback on the API ingress now (feature flag). Rolling to eu-west-4 ingress.

leo: I'll open a temporary routing policy to avoid using idp endpoints within eu-west-4 — route to eu-west-2 for auth validation calls. Pushing change to route-table:```\n# route-table patch\n- region: eu-west-4\n  auth_prefer: eu-west-2\n  priority: 100\n```

priya: Also triggering a scale-up for Dedicated pools in eu-west-4 (add 2x small worker groups) to absorb backlog while routing changes propagate.

evan: Observability note: Ingestly reported degraded writes in eu-west-4 at 04:03 UTC. They've opened a ticket (INC-9981) and are investigating. We should stop relying on them for control-plane metrics — enable local metrics buffering for 10m.

maya: Action list for comms: Tom to send initial "degraded" email to affected customers + status page update. SRE to provide ETA for mitigation within 15m. Product to prepare possible RCA pointers.

tom: Draft support msg: "We're seeing elevated errors and latency in eu-west-4 affecting API calls. Engineers are actively mitigating by routing auth validation and enabling fallback. We expect partial recovery within 15-30 minutes. We'll update on progress." Approving to send now.

incident-bot: sasha acknowledged pager at 04:05:12 UTC.

sasha: Flagging possible regression: a recent ingress config that tightened IDP token TTLs may have contributed. Will check deploys from last 6h.

leo: Rollback candidate found: ingress-auth-config v2.14.3 applied 03:58 UTC. I'm going to roll it back if cached-token fallback isn't fast enough.

priya: After fallback + routing change, p50 latency in eu-west-4 dropped by ~40% and 5xx rate down to 2.8% at 04:17 UTC. Still watching p95.

maya: Good. Tom sent initial comms and support queue notes. We should prepare an incident bridge if we see re-escalation.

incident-bot: Monitoring: continue 1m checks for next 30m.

sasha: Handoff — my pager window ends in 20m. If we still have >3% 5xx at 04:25 UTC, escalate to oncall-rotation for senior-sre. Otherwise I'll post a follow-up and clear pager.

tom: Support update: 9 customers opened tickets. Highlighting 2 enterprise customers on SLAs; both acknowledged and will hold until 04:40 UTC.

priya: Logging snippet from ingress (error path):```\nERROR auth: token fetch failed idp.prod.example.com timeout=2500ms trace_id=abc123\nWARN fallback: using cached token for principal=svc-frontend\n```

leo: Rollback of ingress-auth-config v2.14.3 initiated at 04:22 UTC. If rollback completes cleanly we should see additional improvement in p95.

priya: Observability buffering enabled at 04:09 UTC. Some metrics delayed ~90s but control-plane stability improved.

incident-bot: status update: 04:25 UTC — 5xx rate eu-west-4 = 1.6%, p95 latency trending down. Continue monitoring.

maya: Let's keep this thread open for postmortem notes. Sasha — please hand off final state once you sign out. If cleared, we'll file an incident doc with details: dependency (IDP + Ingestly), triggers (ingress config + provider egress degradation), mitigations (cached-token fallback, routing, rollback), impact (hosted + dedicated), customer comms.

sasha: I'm clear to hand off. Final: mitigation successful, rollback completed, routing policy in place, dedicated pools scaled. Will follow-up with timeline and logs for the postmortem. Clearing pager at 04:30 UTC.

incident-bot: Pager cleared by sasha at 04:30:12 UTC.

maya: Thanks all. Assigning postmortem owner: priya. Expected draft in 48h.

priya: Acknowledged. I'll include runbook gaps: token TTL tuning, per-region ingress egress alerting, and observability fallback tests.

tom: I'll follow up with customers with final update after the PM posts RCA.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging, leaving messages for postmortem additions."
